args.summary:
Fixed the ascii.qdp table format to be case-insensitive when parsing QDP commands. The issue was that the regex pattern used to identify QDP commands (like "READ SERR" or "READ TERR") was case-sensitive, requiring uppercase commands only. Users often create QDP files with lowercase or mixed-case commands, which would fail with "Unrecognized QDP line" errors.

The fix involved adding the `re.IGNORECASE` flag to the regex compilation in the `_line_type` function in `/testbed/astropy/io/ascii/qdp.py` (line 71). This allows the parser to recognize commands in any case combination (e.g., "read serr", "READ SERR", "Read SeRr", etc.).

Additionally, added a comprehensive test case `test_case_insensitive_commands` to ensure this functionality is properly tested going forward. The fix maintains full backward compatibility with existing uppercase commands while enabling support for lowercase and mixed-case commands as expected by users.

cd /testbed && python -c "from astropy.table import Table; t = Table.read('test_mixed.qdp', format='ascii.qdp'); assert len(t) == 1; print('Mixed case: PASS')"
cd /testbed && python -c "from astropy.table import Table; t = Table.read('test_upper.qdp', format='ascii.qdp'); assert len(t) == 1; print('Uppercase (backward compat): PASS')"
